value.rationale: The source paper motivates distinguishing ordinary Dowker from pairwise flagification; prior affine-plane Rips ranks do not resolve what symmetry representations survive flagification. The all-prime-power calculation gives an exact integral affine module and, in odd characteristic, a previously unrecorded degree-shifted bridge from ordinary incidence cycles to high-dimensional flagified topology (exact q3 coincidence and regular summands thereafter). The invariant identifies all translation-character multiplicities and has natural topological and equivariant meaning, not an arbitrary small slice.
